fitted_from: Resource/reports/2026-09-16_predictor_generalisation/results_corpus.json (158 byte-verified runs, 425,726 commanded points, 480,368 replay frames, 33 tracks)
departure_law: joint-space per-joint carry-on: p_pred(k) = FK(q(k) + tau_j (*) qdot(k)), departure = its distance to the commanded pad path, times departure_calibration. Replaced the pad-space law p + tau*pdot on 2026-09-16 after the 158-run corpus test: a lag COMMON to all seven joints lands along the path (0.00 mm perpendicular) and is invisible as a departure, so forming one pad velocity before applying one tau discards the entire effect. Real p95 / predicted p95 = 1.56x taught, 1.99x planned (hence the calibration of 2.0), against 1.94x and 9.08x for the pad-space law.
